close_reason: Fixed in calendars-server (calendar.rs, event.rs, event_notification.rs, participant_identity.rs) by adding upfront validation that every destroy[] entry is a string, returning invalidArguments otherwise per RFC 8620 §5.3. Added regression test set_destroy_rejects_non_string_entry. Per cookie-cutter rule, propagated identical validation to chat-server (8 files), contacts-server (2), filenode-server (1), tasks-server (3), and unified the existing-but-divergent forms in sharing-server (2) and mail-server/sieve.rs to the canonical mail-server/mailbox.rs shape. All 96 test groups pass; clippy clean.
title: Calendar/set destroy ignores non-string entries in the destroy array silently — RFC requires invalidArguments?
